name: Arcanum Spire
blurb: A floating tower of libraries, storms and spells that misfire on purpose.

merchant.name: Zaltor the Arcane
merchant.line: Spells! Spells for the spellless! Press Space and pray, that's my motto.

challenger.name: Sibyl Nightcoil
challenger.line: I have seen your future. It contains three trials and a great deal of yelling.

banker.name: Goldtongue
banker.line: I turn Slithers into Snaycoins, and Snaycoins into regret. Mostly the first one.

boss.name: Hexfang the Archmage
boss.taunt: I have read every book about snakes. You are a footnote.

levels.name: Apprentice Courtyard
levels.text: Spilled potions turned to molasses. Slow is not always bad. Reach 2,500.

levels.name: Rune Circle
levels.text: Spike runes flash up on a beat. Learn the rhythm. Eat 15 apples.

levels.name: Storm Library
levels.text: Lightning strikes where the floor glows first. Survive 45 seconds.

levels.name: Hall of Mirrors
levels.text: Leave by one wall and the hall sends you out of another. Reach 4,000.

levels.name: Lair: The First Hunt
levels.text: Hexfang blinks around the arena. Outlast him until his stamina breaks.

levels.name: Wisp Wood
levels.text: Wisps drift through walls and through you, if you let them. Eat 18.

levels.name: The Familiar's Den
levels.text: A runaway familiar stole the headmaster's spoon. Catch it three times.

levels.name: Spellbound Stacks
levels.text: Three library keys, one locked reading room. Mind the wisps and the weather.

levels.name: Astral Observatory
levels.text: A rival apprentice snake hunts the same apples. Bite its body to stun it. Reach 6,000.

levels.name: Lair: The Armored Duel
levels.text: Hexfang's wards shine silver. Drain him, then bite through the wards.

levels.name: Ley Line Tunnel
levels.text: Ride the ley line 300 meters without falling behind.

levels.name: The Twisting Archive
levels.text: The Forbidden Grimoire is shelved somewhere in the endless stacks. Find it.

levels.name: Glyph Field
levels.text: Five glyph plates, numbered. Press them in order or the field resets them.

levels.name: Pulse of the Spire
levels.text: The tower breathes walls in and out. Reach 7,000 between breaths.

levels.name: Lair: The Last Stand
levels.text: The wards are gone. Wear him out and bite until the Archmage falls.
